total.title: Total Fields
rows: Row 1: PV @ 200 hPa (shading) + EGR contours (≥ 0.5 day⁻¹) + 250 hPa total wind vectors
Row 2: PV @ 850 hPa (shading) + T-adv contours (blue dashed = cold, red solid = warm) + 850 hPa total wind + SLP
Row 3: AFC @ 250 hPa (shading) + 250 hPa wind (≥ 30 m/s) + RK sign-reversal hatching + KE-adv contours

anom.title: Climatology-Relative Anomaly Fields
rows: Row 1: PV' @ 200 hPa (shading) + EGR contours + 250 hPa anomaly wind (u', v' = departure from 1991–2020 climatology)
Row 2: PV' @ 850 hPa (shading) + T-adv anomaly contours + 850 hPa anomaly wind + SLP
Row 3: AFC (total, shading) + 250 hPa anomaly wind + RK hatching + KE-adv anomaly contours

epall_anom.title: EPALL-Relative Anomaly
epall_anom.columns: EP1 − EPALL | EP2 − EPALL | EP3 − EPALL
rows: Row 1: (PV @ 200 hPa) − EPALL + EGR contours + (u, v)_250 − EPALL wind vectors
Row 2: (PV @ 850 hPa) − EPALL + (T-adv) − EPALL contours + (u, v)_850 − EPALL wind + SLP

Row 3: AFC total (shading, no EPALL-relative version; climatological decomp by construction) + (u, v)_250 − EPALL wind + RK total sign-reversal hatching (total RK, not EPALL-relative — background-flow diagnostic) + (KE-adv) − EPALL contours
